record.category: currency exchange rate API and central-bank rate datasets, keyless

free_tier.stated: No key and no account: the ECB reference table re-based to any of 30 currencies once a day, and the latest table of each central bank and tax authority; 120 requests a minute per IP address.
free_tier.notes: The ECB endpoint is /api/open/latest/{BASE}; the central-bank tables are /api/open/central-bank/{code}, with csv, xml and xlsx output. A table for a past date, a date range and the calendars need a key. A public page that shows the rates carries a visible link to AllRatesToday; back-end use needs no link. The keyless central-bank tables are for development, evaluation, personal projects and internal tooling. A machine caller may also issue itself a trial key with one POST: 100 lifetime calls, valid 7 days, no email and no captcha, 3 keys per IP address a day.

retention.stated: not applicable: a query API and a dataset with no stored objects

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the per-IP request rate bounds what a caller can pull

record.interface_detail: GET https://allratestoday.com/api/open/latest/USD returns JSON with CORS enabled; the central-bank tables and the GitHub dataset also give csv
record.tooling: curl or any HTTP client; a browser can call the ECB endpoint directly
record.chaining: Daily ECB reference rates for invoices and reports with no sign-up. For a bulk history, the GitHub dataset holds one CSV file per source and year.

limits.value: 120 requests a minute per IP address, then HTTP 429 with Retry-After
latest table only on the keyless endpoints; a past date or a range needs a key

record.limits_note: Currency coverage: 30 currencies in the ECB table. The site also lists a Hugging Face dataset and a Kaggle dataset.
record.binding_note: The 120 a minute per IP address bounds a burst, but the table changes once a day, so the daily refresh and the latest-only rule bind in practice.

identity_cost.detail: No key and no account for the open endpoints and the GitHub dataset. The agent trial key needs one POST with no email and no captcha.

record.reliability_note: Over the per-IP rate the endpoint answers HTTP 429 with Retry-After. The ECB table changes once a day, and the page asks for at most one request an hour per server.
record.confidence_note: Rate, coverage and licence are quoted from first-party pages. One keyless GET of the ECB endpoint answered HTTP 200 with the ECB table; the 429 cut-off was not measured.

record.category: currency exchange rate API (live mid-market rates and central-bank reference rates)

free_tier.stated: Free plan, EUR 0, no card: 1 API key and 10 requests a minute on live mid-market rates; the free request count is a lifetime total that never resets, and the pages read do not publish its size.
free_tier.notes: The docs rate table lists the Free request count only as the word Free on a lifetime period. The next plan up, Small, is EUR 4.99 a month for 5,000 requests a month, reset at 00:00 UTC on the first of each calendar month. Each call costs 1 request, and one call may name many target currencies. A range of history on a free key answers 403 historical_requires_paid_plan. The latest table of any central bank is on the free key. The same pages offer keyless lanes, which have their own record (data-apis/allratestoday-open).

per_object_cap.notes: Many targets in one call count as one request.

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the lifetime request total bounds what a free key can pull

record.interface_detail: GET https://allratestoday.com/api/v1/rates?source=USD&target=EUR,GBP with the key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header; csv, xml and xlsx output on table endpoints
record.chaining: Live mid-market rates for a prototype. The keyless lane in data-apis/allratestoday-open needs no key and carries the daily ECB table and the central-bank datasets.

limits.value: a lifetime total of Free requests that never resets; its size is not published on the pages read
10 requests a minute on the Free plan

record.limits_note: History: a from or to range, or a time value, on a free key answers 403 historical_requires_paid_plan. Bulk path: none on the free key; the keyless GitHub dataset in data-apis/allratestoday-open is the bulk route.
record.binding_note: The lifetime total never resets, so it ends the key long before 10 requests a minute matters; its size is not published.

identity_cost.detail: Sign-up by email and password, or Google or GitHub sign-in; no card. The docs say registration has a captcha and an email to verify.

record.reliability_note: Past the quota the API answers HTTP 429 and does not recover until the plan changes; the docs say there is no Retry-After header and the body carries resets_at.
record.confidence_note: Read from the first-party docs, pricing, free-API and sign-up pages. No key was created, so the lifetime count and the 429 cut-off were not measured.
